method: Hashed isolated P4.7 retry-1 source, with 20 focused controls/mobile/card cases required before the full 64-case regression. Eleven new controls/mobile checks plus nine card checks cover all 21 classifications/provenance, units/physical scale invariance/missing timestamps, public commands/history/share, and 390x844, 390x430, 844x390 mobile snaps/scroll/focus/timeline boundaries, plus all 44 prior checks. Warm local lookup (1000 samples, maximum below 16 ms), production build/budgets/licenses and all 64 production browser/HTTP/renderer cases. Production search leases hold the resident last 3D frame during modal interaction and canonical route/card paint; simulation time continues. Ten search cases include keyboard/IME/touch/rendering ownership and desktop/phone maximum response at most 300 ms, without timing recorder overhead. The 62 functional cases keep traces and SwiftShader; the two timing cases select a physical GPU and reject missing/software scene adapters. Phone is desktop-GPU viewport/touch emulation. Prior software timing failures remain preserved. Existing configured-origin and CPU evidence remain separate; no root output/server changes.

localVerify.finalMeasurementChecks: Full verification includes consumer shell, preference validation, UTC/provenance and package boundary checks; 64 cases discovered in twelve specs

protocol.timingRecorder: trace/video/screenshot off only for latency cases; functional cases retain traces
protocol.presentation: Production search modal holds last scene frame; time continues; resume after canonical route/card paint; no test-only rendering stop
protocol.renderer: 62 SwiftShader WebGL2 functional cases; two timing cases require a verified physical scene GPU (Windows ANGLE/D3D11), recording actual unmasked adapter; missing/software adapters fail. Phone is viewport/touch emulation on that desktop GPU, not physical phone throughput. Prior SwiftShader response failure remains preserved
protocol.cpu: Not repeated: P4.7 samples existing public getters on the existing throttled bridge; no engine/frame/provider/physics changes. Accepted P4.2 pair remains separately recorded

failure.message: controlsProbe failed: Incomplete/failed/skipped/flaky coverage; inspect controlsProbe.json and controlsProbe-stderr.log
